title: Gibson Tool Manifest
description: Schema for tool.gibson.zeroroot.ai/v1 tool manifests. Use a YAML editor with yaml-language-server support to get autocomplete: # yaml-language-server: $schema=schema.json

kind.description: Must be 'Tool'. Maps to gibson.identity.v1.PrincipalKind.PRINCIPAL_KIND_TOOL. Sister schemas exist for 'Agent' and 'Plugin' manifests.

name.description: DNS-label-style identifier for the tool. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9]$.

version.description: Semantic version of the tool (e.g. '1.2.3' or '0.1.0-alpha').

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the tool.

author.description: Optional identifier for the tool's author.

input_proto.description: Fully-qualified proto message type for the tool's request envelope (e.g. 'gibson.tools.nmap.v1.ScanRequest').

output_proto.description: Fully-qualified proto message type for the tool's response envelope (e.g. 'gibson.tools.nmap.v1.ScanResponse').

image.description: Container image reference the tool runs as. Setec launches an ephemeral microVM from this image per call.

env.description: Environment variables passed into the sandboxed runtime. Values may reference declared secrets via 'secret:<broker-name>'.

secrets.description: Declared credential needs. May be empty when the tool requires no credentials.

egress.description: Declared external network targets. Enforced by the Setec sandbox.

timeout.description: Maximum duration a single tool invocation may run. Go duration string (e.g. '60s'). Defaults to '60s'.

scope.description: When the secret is resolved: 'startup' (once at start) or 'per_call' (each invocation).

rotation.description: How the tool reacts to a rotation event: 'live' (cache invalidation) or 'restart' (exit 75).

required.description: When true, missing secret blocks tool startup.

ResourceLimits.description: Per-invocation resource quotas applied by the Setec sandbox.

EgressDecl.description: A single external network target the tool contacts.

host.description: DNS name or wildcard pattern (e.g. '*.example.com'). IP addresses are not permitted.

port.description: Destination port number. Must be in [1, 65535].

purpose.description: Optional human-readable description of why this egress target is needed.
